periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the sagittal facial midline, oriented towards the ventral-lateral aspect of the skull.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid, with the primary axis approximately 1.8 times the width of the secondary axis relative to the facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering extending toward the maxillary region of the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curvature at the posterior boundary where the transverse dark band meets the posterior torso fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 0.45 relative to the total visible longitudinal axis of the torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance is approximately 1.2 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a consistent semi-circular convex curvature on the superior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reddish-brown pigmentation/staining visible across the fur of the posterior torso and hindlimbs.
